subject: health

location.courseTitle: Health III: Consumer Health, Safety, and Emergency Response

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the private-safe task without disclosing medical history, diagnosis, body measurements, or sexual history.
Use a fictional scenario when offered and identify a trusted adult or qualified professional where appropriate.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain how chronic conditions develop and why single causes are rare in your own words and give a valid example.
Use a cited source, diagram, model, or documented process to show understanding of modifiable and non-modifiable factors, stated without moralizing.
Apply genetics, environment, access, and stress as real contributors in a new fictional situation. Show the decision process or cite the evidence used.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, or unsafe choice involving sleep, movement, and recovery as long-horizon inputs; correct it and explain why.

Connect screening, early detection, and routine care over a lifetime with living well with an ongoing condition, and why stigma harms outcomes. Explain how the two support, constrain, or build on one another.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Build a twenty-year wellbeing model for a fictional adult, showing which inputs are inside personal control, which are structural, and which supports change the picture most.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy of health information criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill application criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. No assessment requires disclosure, a recording, or any body measurement.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Chronic Conditions and Long-Horizon Wellbeing?
